name: AI Avatar
author: hlasensky
description: A little creature that lives on your screen edge and walks around whenever an AI CLI is running, rests when it's idle, and can be dragged to any edge of the screen.

barWidget.description: Ambient activity mascot — walks while an AI CLI (claude, codex, aider, ollama…) is running.

schema.label: Walk speed (ms per screen width; higher = slower)
